summary.text: Great Qi Grasp is an immortal killer move named when Demon Immortal Qi Jue faces Di Zang Sheng.

claims.text: Di Zang Sheng charges toward Demon Immortal Qi Jue. He does not dodge. He extends his small hand toward Di Zang Sheng. Immortal killer move great qi grasp is named. Endless white qi currents shoot out of his body and form a giant hand with five fingers. The hand starts the size of an Immortal Gu House, inflates to a hill, and after three breaths matches the Evil Dragon’s head while still growing. Di Zang Sheng collides with it and destroys the formed hand in one move, then keeps pursuing. After a few seconds Di Zang Sheng slows and growls in pain. Demon Immortal Qi Jue says it can form and scatter at will, grab mountains and seas if it takes form, and invade organs when it scatters.

White qi waves surge above qi sea. Demon Immortal Qi Jue’s boyish figure is visible in the waves. He has come to borrow Gu. Fang Yuan stands on the surface of the sea. Immortal killer move great qi grasp is named. A milky white qi current hand flies out like a small mountain, pressing down. Fang Yuan extends his hand and pushes forward. A qi wall a hundred li long soars up, collides with the hand, and forces it back. Demon Immortal Qi Jue points his finger and the hand scatters, attempting to infiltrate the wall as countless currents. The densely packed wall cannot be penetrated.
